scope: Untrained temporal diagnostic using frozen RGB models; no phone or rep counter changes
freshSelection: 16 lowest member-name SHA256 uninventoried recordings from Kinetics7002020 val454; no replacements; retain native failures
tracking: Shoulder center/span continuity over all native4Hz poses; overhead acquisition; two observation dwell; ambiguous target resets; no manual targets
evidence: At most one observation per source second and one vote across both hands; same RGB hash deduplicated; arithmetic averaging only; minimum two bins separated1s; eight-second bank; track changes/conflicts abstain
gripSemantics: Front palm/rear dorsum=>overhand; front dorsum/rear palm=>underhand. Unknown/oblique direction abstains binary. Neutral requires frozen prior grip head neutral>=.8 for all three supplied views; side surface alone never suffices. Conflicting binary/neutral signals abstain. These rules are an offline experiment, not trained/qualified fusion.
orientation: Frozen torso-only RGB orientation; all five face cues zero; missing context uniform; causal arithmetic mean of one observation/sec
comparisons: frame-gated: per-frame anatomy/visibility/contact and torso confidence, same semantic mapping
temporal-contact-support: stable torso + >=2 consistent bins + at least one qualifying contact
references: Source video grip and torso view plus actual tight-crop surface/contact labels before inference. Agent review, human status separately recorded. No guessed labels for unreadable evidence. All unknown/native failures retained.
evaluation: 16-video correct/wrong/unknown/unverifiable final labels; per-class counts; first-decision source time only on correct final labels; crop diagnostics; privileged oracle-view ablation labelled separately; no post-test candidate selection
budget: No fitting; reuse3 frozen models; bounded127sourceframes; prune unreferenced PNG afterfixed sampling; preserve provenance
storage: Original videos, selected RGB, crops, model files and first scores retained. Delete only reproducible unreferenced cache.
